captions.detailed: A 3D-printable modular shelving unit shaped like a Tetris 'L' piece. The unit has thin, uniform outer walls and a hollow interior, functioning as an open container or shelf compartment. Inside, low-profile dividing ribs form a grid pattern along the back wall, providing structural reinforcement and compartmentalization.
captions.instruction: Create a parametric OpenSCAD script for modular Tetris-shaped shelving units. The design should allow the user to select the Tetris shape (I, J, L, O, S, Z, T), adjust the grid size, wall thickness, depth, and toggle a reinforced grid pattern on the back wall.
captions.factory: The script uses 2D polygons to define the basic Tetris shapes (I, J, L, O, S, Z, T) and their offset inner cutouts. The selected shape is scaled by the grid size and extruded using linear_extrude to the specified depth. A boolean difference operation hollows out the shape using the corresponding offset polygon, while a separate module creates a triangular-profile cutting grid to form the reinforced back-wall pattern.
